name: Data Analyzer: One session cannot read another session's saved dictionary
objective: Proves cached parsed dictionaries are private to the browser session that created them.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Session A stores a made-up rule set under a key; session B asks for the same key
Session A asks for the same key
steps.expected: Session A gets its rule set back

name: Data Analyzer: Clearing the cache removes only the current session's entries
objective: Proves one user's 'clear' does not delete another's data.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Each session stores one entry; session A clears
steps.expected: Clear reports 1 removed and session A's count is 0

steps.action: Session B asks for its entry
steps.expected: Session B's entry is still there

name: Data Analyzer: Entry count covers only the current session
objective: Proves the count does not reveal how many entries other sessions hold.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Session A stores 1 entry and session B stores 2; each asks for its count
steps.expected: Session A sees 1 and session B sees 2

name: Data Analyzer: Old shared-folder cache files are never read
objective: Proves entries left in the earlier shared layout (including ones named with the old and the new hash) cannot be loaded.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Put two files directly in the cache folder named by the MD5 and SHA-256 hashes of made-up bytes, each holding a rule set 'evil'; then look up that content in a session
steps.expected: Nothing is returned and the session's count is 0

name: Data Analyzer: Cache keys use SHA-256, not the weaker MD5
objective: Proves cache keys are 64-character SHA-256 fingerprints, with a '_llm' suffix for AI-parsed results.

steps.action: Make a key for the bytes 'abc', with and without the AI marker
steps.expected: Plain key equals the SHA-256 of 'abc' and is 64 characters; with the AI marker it is that key plus '_llm'

name: Data Analyzer: Expired cache entries are not returned and are deleted
objective: Proves old entries stop being served and are removed from disk.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions. Lifetime set to 60 seconds.

steps.action: Store an entry, backdate its file by an hour, and ask for it
steps.expected: Nothing is returned and the file no longer exists

name: Data Analyzer: Housekeeping removes other sessions' expired entries and keeps fresh ones
objective: Proves old data from any session is cleaned up without touching recent entries.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions. Lifetime 60 seconds.

steps.action: Session B stores a 'stale' and a 'fresh' entry; the stale file is backdated an hour; session A runs prune
steps.expected: Prune reports 1 removed; the stale file is gone and the fresh file remains

name: Data Analyzer: Cache lifetime can be set by an environment variable
objective: Proves UI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS controls how long entries live.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Set UI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS to 2 and create a cache

name: Data Analyzer: Session identifiers that could escape the cache folder are rejected
objective: Proves a crafted session id cannot be used to reach other folders.
precondition: A temporary folder as cache folder.

steps.action: Create a cache with each bad session id
steps.data: '../etc', 'short', 32 characters containing 'G' (not hexadecimal), empty text, nothing at all
steps.expected: A ValueError is raised each time

name: Data Analyzer: Cache keys that could escape the session folder are rejected
objective: Proves a crafted key cannot write outside the session's folder.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Try to store under each bad key
steps.expected: A ValueError is raised each time

name: Data Analyzer: Cache files are readable only by their owner
objective: Proves saved cache files are not accessible to other users of the machine.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Store an entry and read the file's permission bits
steps.expected: No permission is granted to group or others (the 'group/other' bits are zero)

name: Data Analyzer: A damaged cache file is treated as not found, not as a crash
objective: Proves invalid file contents cause a normal 'not cached' result.
precondition: A temporary folder is used as the cache folder. Two made-up 32-character session identifiers (all 'a' and all 'b') stand for two browser sessions.

steps.action: Write the broken text '{not json' as an entry file and ask for it
steps.expected: Nothing is returned and no error is raised

name: Data Analyzer: Page source no longer shows the cache location or uses the shared/legacy cache
objective: Proves the page code has dropped the shared cache folder, the path display, the 'clear all' button, MD5 and pickle.
precondition: The page source web_app.py is read as text, not run.
